phrases.黑洞已锁定中央区域，整局都会限制 AI 进入: Black Hole: the center is sealed off from the AI for the whole game.

phrases.该点已被傀儡术预留给 AI: Your Puppet card has reserved this point for the AI.
phrases.这手属于自杀禁着，不能这样下: Suicide isn't allowed: your own stones would have no liberties left.

phrases.这里汇总 Rogue AI 的玩法、闯关路线，以及所有 Rogue 卡牌的效果说: This index covers Rogue AI game variants, challenge runs, and the full effect list for every Rogue card.
phrases.高级：手动设置等级、让子和贴目: Advanced: set rank, handicap and komi by hand
phrases.对局：选择难度即可。AI 强度固定，难度决定你得到几颗让子。想自己设置等级、让子: Game: just pick a difficulty. The AI's strength is fixed; difficulty sets how many handicap stones you get. Tick Advanced to set rank, handicap and komi yourself.
phrases.当前玩法：单人抽卡。固定 19×19，只有你带 Rogue 卡；难度决定贴目。: Current variant: Solo Draft. Fixed at 19x19. Only you use a Rogue card; difficulty sets the komi.

wikiModes.title: Solo Draft
wikiModes.desc: You draft 1 Rogue card from 3 choices. The AI plays standard rules with no Rogue card of its own.

wikiModes.title: Dual Draft
wikiModes.desc: You pick 1 Rogue card from 3 choices, and the AI also receives 1 card from the restricted AI Rogue pool.

wikiModes.title: Ultimate Duel
wikiModes.desc: You and the AI each pick 1 ultimate card from 3 choices. The game resolves in a 20-move showdown.

wikiModes.title: Challenge
wikiModes.desc: Challenge mode layers card-pool restrictions, handicap, and refresh counts for staged runs.

tengen.name: Tengen
tengen.desc: The AI must open at tengen, then its next 1 move is restricted to the 5x5 diamond around tengen.
tengen.summary: The AI must open at tengen and stay near it for one more move.

dice.name: Dice Roll
dice.desc: Each AI move has a 10% chance of being skipped entirely.
dice.summary: Each AI move has a 6% chance to become a pass.

erosion.name: Erosion
erosion.desc: Every capture shifts komi by 4 points in the captor's favor.
erosion.summary: Every capture moves komi 4 points toward the capturer.

puppet.name: Puppet
puppet.desc: Mark the AI's next forced point first. You play your move, then the AI must answer there (once per game).
puppet.summary: Once: pick a point and the AI must play there next.

seal.name: Seal
seal.desc: Mark 4 forbidden points the AI cannot touch for the whole game.
seal.summary: Seal 4 points the AI can never play on.

twin.name: Combo
twin.desc: Play two moves in a single turn once per game for a local follow-up.
twin.summary: Once: play two moves in a row.

nerf.name: Nerf
nerf.desc: Drop the AI by about 8 ranks, crush its search power to roughly 5%, and make its first 12 moves much more likely to mis-pick backup options.
nerf.summary: The AI plays about 8 ranks weaker, especially early on.

komi_relief.name: Komi Cut
komi_relief.desc: Komi shifts 7 points in your favor.
komi_relief.summary: Komi moves 7 points in your favor.

time_press.name: Time Crunch
time_press.desc: Drop the AI by about 5 ranks, cap it at 0.10 seconds per move, and make its first 12 moves much more likely to misread under time pressure.
time_press.summary: The AI plays about 5 ranks weaker and rushes every move.

lowline.name: Low Sweep
lowline.desc: For its first 5 moves, the AI prefers low 2nd- and 3rd-line points.
lowline.summary: The AI's first 5 moves lean toward the low 2nd and 3rd lines.

suboptimal.name: Second Best
suboptimal.desc: For its first 8 moves, the AI is much more likely to choose weaker backup options.
suboptimal.summary: The AI's first 8 moves often pick a weaker option.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.desc: 16% chance the AI mirrors your last move across the board.
mirror.summary: 16% chance the AI copies your last move, mirrored.

slip.name: Butterfingers
slip.desc: 14% chance the AI slips to a straight-adjacent point.
slip.summary: 12% chance each AI move slips to a neighboring point.

blackhole.name: Black Hole
blackhole.desc: The central 13-point zone is off-limits to the AI for its first 6 moves.
blackhole.summary: The AI can never play in the central black-hole zone.

exchange.name: Turn Steal
exchange.desc: Force the AI to pass — you keep playing (once per game).
exchange.summary: Once: move one enemy stone to any empty point, for free.

fog.name: Fog of War
fog.desc: For the AI's first 11 moves, refresh a 3x3 no-go zone. After that, block 1 AI-forbidden point each turn inside the 3x3 diamond around the AI's previous move.
fog.summary: Shifting no-go zones block the AI, mostly in the opening.

gravity.name: Gravity Well
gravity.desc: The AI is pulled toward star points for 5 moves.
gravity.summary: The AI's first 6 moves must be on star points.

golden_corner.name: Golden Corner
golden_corner.desc: A random 4×4 corner is sealed off from the AI for its first 10 moves.
golden_corner.summary: One random corner is off-limits to the AI all game.

sansan.name: 3-3 Rush
sansan.desc: For its first 2 moves, the AI is forced to open on the four 3-3 points, then avoids corner 4×4 zones for 2 moves.
sansan.summary: The AI's first 3 moves must go in the 3-3 corner zones.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.desc: On its first 2 moves, the AI has a high chance to cling to its previous stone.
shadow.summary: 18% chance each AI move must stay next to its last one.

sprout.name: Sprout
sprout.desc: After each of your captures, spawn 1 friendly stone at random within a 3x3 area around the captured point.
sprout.summary: Every capture grows 1 free stone next to it.

joseki_ocd.name: Joseki OCD
joseki_ocd.desc: 7 target points appear. Hit any 4 of them to auto-fill the remaining 3 with your stones.
joseki_ocd.summary: Hit 4 of 7 marked points and the other 3 fill in for you.

handicap_quest.name: Handicap Quest
handicap_quest.desc: Pass once to start; after every 8 moves you force an AI pass, up to 3 times.
handicap_quest.summary: Pass once, then every 8 moves the AI is forced to pass (up to 3 times).

god_hand.name: Hand of God
god_hand.desc: Step on a hidden diamond zone — 3 friendly stones burst into nearby empty points inside a 3×3 area.
god_hand.summary: Find the hidden spot to get 3 free stones around it.

sansan_trap.name: 3-3 Trap
sansan_trap.desc: Only if the opponent's very first move lands on any 3-3 point, you immediately gain 8 nearby counter-stones.
sansan_trap.summary: Whenever the AI takes a 3-3 point, you get a free stone beside it.

corner_helper.name: Corner Guard
corner_helper.desc: Each corner can trigger once. If any corner's 5×5 area has 4 of your stones, that corner gains 1 reinforcement.
corner_helper.summary: 4 of your stones in a corner earn that corner 1 free stone.

sanrensei.name: Three Stars
sanrensei.desc: If your first 3 moves are all on star points, 2 additional empty star points receive your stones. All game long: when three of your stones line up evenly spaced with empty points between them (like one-space jumps), the constellation lights up and adds 1 stone on that line (at most every 6 moves, 3 times per game).
sanrensei.summary: Open on 3 star points for 2 free stones; evenly spaced lines of 3 add more.

no_regret.name: No Regrets
no_regret.desc: Undo disabled — but each move has a 12% chance to add a free stone.
no_regret.summary: No undo, but after each AI move there's an 8% chance of a free stone.

quickthink.name: Quick Think
quickthink.desc: Play within 2 seconds to open a 1-second combo window. Timeout becomes a pass, and hints plus undo are disabled.
quickthink.summary: Move within 2 seconds for a bonus move; too slow and you pass. No hints or undo.

foolish_wisdom.name: Wise Fool
foolish_wisdom.desc: Form an ugly shape to sprout 1 bonus stone in the nearby 5x5 area.
foolish_wisdom.summary: Make an ugly shape and a free stone grows nearby.

five_in_row.name: Five in a Row
five_in_row.desc: When you form exactly 5 in a row, spawn 1 friendly stone in each 3x3 area at the two ends.
five_in_row.summary: Make exactly 5 in a row to get 1 free stone at each end.

coach_mode.name: Coach Login
coach_mode.desc: Active: a stronger AI plays the next 30 turns for you. If your winrate stays below 50% after that, it plays 10 extra turns.
coach_mode.summary: Active: a stronger AI plays your next 30 moves.

capture_foul.name: Capture Foul
capture_foul.desc: When the opponent captures 4 stones in one move or cumulatively, gift 1 friendly stone on your next recommended point, then reset the counter.
capture_foul.summary: Every 4 stones the AI captures earns you a free stone on a good point.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc: Once per game, if your winrate drops below 26%, remove 1 enemy stone and add 1 friendly stone inside the last move's 3×3 area without landing on forbidden points.
last_stand.summary: Once, when your winrate drops below 26%: remove 1 enemy stone near the last move and add 1 of yours.

defense_first.name: Defense First
defense_first.desc: Starting with your 3rd move, if your last 3 moves each have no enemy stone within their 5x5 area, spawn 1 friendly stone within a 5x5 area around any of your stones. Triggers up to twice per game.
defense_first.summary: 3 calm moves in a row away from the enemy earn a free stone (twice a game).

attack_first.name: Attack First
attack_first.desc: If your last 3 moves are each within a 3x3 area around enemy stones, spawn 1 friendly stone next to the enemy stones you just attacked. Triggers up to twice per game.
attack_first.summary: 3 moves in a row right next to enemy stones earn a free stone (twice a game).

methodical.name: Methodical
methodical.desc: Each of your turns resolves after you play 2 stones in sequence; every 10th player turn grants 1 extra stone for a 3-stone turn.
methodical.summary: Play 2 stones every turn, and 3 on every 10th turn.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.desc: Each move in contact with enemy stones (or that captures) builds a streak. Every 3rd attack in a row adds 1 of your stones next to the enemy. A non-contact move resets the streak. Up to 5 times per game.
momentum.summary: Keep attacking: every 3rd contact move in a row adds a free stone.

iron_wall.name: Iron Wall
iron_wall.desc: Each move that connects to your own stones without touching the enemy builds a streak. Every 3rd defence in a row adds 1 stone on a liberty of your weakest group. Touching the enemy or playing alone resets it. Up to 5 times per game.
iron_wall.summary: Keep connecting solidly: every 3rd move in a row shores up your weakest group.

capture_chain.name: Capture Chain
capture_chain.desc: Capture on consecutive turns to chain: from the 2nd capture in a row, extra stones of yours drop around the captured spot (1, then 2). A turn without a capture resets the chain. Up to 5 times per game.
capture_chain.summary: Capture on back-to-back turns for bonus stones: 1, then 2.

chain.name: Chain Strike
chain.desc: Every move has an 80% chance to grant an extra turn.

proliferate.name: Infinite Bloom
proliferate.desc: After you play, 5 same-color stones bloom in a 5×5 zone.

double.name: Dual Blades
double.desc: Every turn becomes a 2-move combo, but the whole burst only counts as 1 move.

wildgrow.name: Wild Growth
wildgrow.desc: 4 of your stones spread outward into empty space.

rejection.name: Repulsion
rejection.desc: Enemy stones in the 5×5 zone are pushed away or destroyed.

territory.name: Absolute Zone
territory.desc: Create a 4-step forbidden barrier around your move.

shadow_clone.name: Shadow Clone
shadow_clone.desc: Create a mirrored stone now. One turn later, the original point and mirror point are forced into a full line even if either endpoint was removed.
shadow_clone.summary: Make a mirror stone; next turn a full line joins it to the original.

plague.name: Plague
plague.desc: Convert every enemy stone in the 5x5 area to your color.

meteor.name: Meteor Strike
meteor.desc: Randomly obliterate 5 enemy stones anywhere on the board.

quantum.name: Quantum Surge
quantum.desc: 5 same-color stones materialize at random positions.

devour.name: Devour
devour.desc: Erase every enemy stone in the surrounding 5×5 area.

timewarp.name: Time Rift
timewarp.desc: 85% chance to erase the opponent's last 2 moves from existence.

blackout.name: Cataclysm
blackout.desc: Wipe all enemy stones in a cross pattern from your move.

magnet.name: Magnet Pull
magnet.desc: Your stones rush toward the point, crushing enemies in their path.

necro.name: Necromancy
necro.desc: Summon 3 friendly stones and convert 2 enemy stones.

wall.name: Great Wall
wall.desc: 60% chance to trigger. Fill an entire row or column with an impassable stone wall.

joseki_burst.name: Joseki Burst
joseki_burst.desc: Complete joseki points, then detonate 50 bonus stones.

god_hand.name: Hand of God
god_hand.desc: Trigger the hidden diamond — wipe enemies and flood the board with 50 stones.

corner_helper.name: Corner Fortress
corner_helper.desc: Each corner can trigger once. If a corner's 5×5 area has 2 of your stones, that corner's 8×8 boundary is filled and enemies inside are cleared.
corner_helper.summary: 2 of your stones in a corner fill the whole corner and clear the enemy.

sanrensei.name: Star Ignition
sanrensei.desc: Play your first 3 moves on star points to ignite star-point influence across the board.

quickthink.name: Speed Storm
quickthink.desc: Place unlimited stones for 5 seconds — then the AI reads the board. The whole burst counts as 1 move.

foolish_wisdom.name: Fool's Chain
foolish_wisdom.desc: Ugly-shape chain reaction spawns up to 20 stones until it stops.

five_in_row.name: Five in a Row Burst
five_in_row.desc: This is Gomoku, not Go. Whenever your stones form exactly 5 in a row, remove 30 enemy stones and drop 30 friendly stones across the board. This effect can chain.
five_in_row.summary: Each exact 5 in a row wipes 30 enemy stones and drops 30 of yours.

capture_foul.name: Capture Foul
capture_foul.desc: Whenever the opponent captures or removes more than 5 stones (including card effects), the foul triggers with 100% certainty. The offender immediately loses 50 points, then the counter resets and can trigger again.
capture_foul.summary: If the opponent removes more than 5 stones at once, they lose 50 points.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc: If your winrate drops below 30%, clear 30 enemy stones and add 30 friendly stones across the entire board.
